g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud Batch risk simulation on Spot VMs with Managed Lustre and BigQuery

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: At close of market Cloud Scheduler starts the risk workflow
The day's market data is exported from BigQuery as scenario files
The workflow submits a Batch job with 10,000 tasks
Batch creates Spot VMs across three zones and retries tasks on preempted ones
Tasks share intermediate paths on Managed Lustre
and write value-at-risk results to BigQuery
The workflow publishes the run's status
to the risk portal on Cloud Run
where analysts can also start an ad-hoc run
Analysts read the risk reports in Looker
